title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a typescript page numbered '- 25 -'. Its content and style are unrelated to the surrounding manuscript notes on the Galois theory of motives, Brandt groupoids, and Deuring quaternion orders. It is most likely the verso of a reused typescript, or a stray page of a course or text on analytic differential equations. Grothendieck's authorship is doubtful.

Mathematically it is the classical Cauchy method of majorants (calcul des limites). It proves existence of an analytic solution, with analytic dependence on parameters z_1..z_q, of a system dy_i/dx = f_i(x, y_1..y_p, z_1..z_q) with y_i(0)=0. The f_i are given by convergent series (14) with coefficients g_i(n; r_1..r_p; λ_1..λ_q). The formal solution y_i = Σ h_i(m; μ) x^m z^μ has coefficients fixed recursively by (15) under index conditions (16).

One picks nonnegative G_i majorizing |g_i| and defines H_i by the same recursion (17): H_i(0; μ)=0 and m H_i(m; μ) = Σ G_i(n; r; λ) ∏_j ∏_{k≤r_j} H(s_kj; ν_kj). Induction on total degree gives |h_i| ≤ H_i, so Σ H_i t^m w^μ majorizes Σ h_i x^m z^μ.

It then suffices to choose the G_i so that the majorant series converge. Take the common majorant M / ((1-αt)(1-αΣv_i)(1-αΣw_ℓ)), valid for M large and α small. One must then solve system (18), dv_k/dt = that expression, with v_k(0)=0. By symmetry all v_k equal a single v solving one scalar separable ODE; this is where the page breaks off. The solution is explicit: v - (αp/2)v^2 = -(M/(α(1-αΣw))) log(1-αt), hence analytic near 0. Entirely textbook material.
errors: In (17) the inner factors of the product should be H_j(s_kj; ν_kj1..ν_kjq), indexed by the variable j, not H_i. The factor v_j^{r_j} expands into r_j copies of the series for v_j. The typescript writes H_i, apparently a typo.
Minor: the summation index i in Σ v_i inside the majorant clashes with the free index i used elsewhere. This is harmless.

ideas.what: Majorant-series proof of existence and analyticity (in parameters) of solutions of analytic ODE systems, reducing to a symmetric scalar ODE
ideas.modern_name: Cauchy's method of majorants (calcul des limites); Cauchy existence theorem for analytic ODE
ideas.usually_credited_to: Cauchy (1830s–1840s); textbook versions in Goursat, Dieudonné, etc.
ideas.where_published: Standard textbooks (e.g. Goursat, Cours d'analyse; Dieudonné, Foundations of Modern Analysis)

deep.surprise_reason: A routine typescript page of the classical Cauchy majorant argument, likely a reused sheet or stray page not by Grothendieck. It has no link to the motivic and Brandt-groupoid notes around it.
transcription_corrections: 'est une {+m+}ajorante': the typescript reads 'amjorante' with a handwritten correction to 'majorante'.
In the product of (17) the typescript prints H_i; mathematically it should be H_j. The transcription faithfully reproduces the typescript.
Summation subscript under Σ in (17) is handwritten 'n,(r_j),(λ_ℓ)'; this is correctly rendered.
